title: ADM: missing error responses section (inconsistent with FCM and HPK)
description: The FCM and HPK sections each have an 'Error responses' subsection explaining that the HTTP status code alone is not reliable and implementers must parse the response body. The ADM section has no such guidance. ADM has specific error codes (InvalidRegistrationId, Unregistered, MaxRateExceeded, MessageTooLarge) in the response body that determine the correct action. Without this section, ADM implementers may handle errors incorrectly — retrying on unregistered tokens, or destroying subscriptions on transient errors.
